MGVI v0.6.1

Diff since v0.6.0

  • Fix a large slowdown of reverse-mode AD through product distributions with Distributions v0.25.133 and newer (#80). This also corrects the flat parameters of products of multivariate normal distributions under Zygote.
  • Allow DensityInterface v1.

Merged pull requests:

  • Re-enable 32-bit CI (#75) (@oschulz)
  • Update URLs after move to JuliaBayes organization (#78) (@oschulz)
  • Align documentation code styling (#79) (@BJMCox)
  • Flatten distribution parameters without the generic params fold (#80) (@oschulz)
